class.name: kontrolem_description/CartPoleSimSystem
class.description: Self-contained ros2_control simulation hardware for fixed-base Euclidean robots. Integrates the URDF's true rigid-body dynamics with kontrolem_model ABA, so the control loop can run end-to-end without Gazebo.

class.name: kontrolem_description/FloatingBaseSimSystem
class.description: Floating-base simulation hardware (M3 spike): integrates SE(3) rigid-body dynamics and exports the base pose/twist as scalar state interfaces on a <gpio> block, to test non-joint state through ros2_control.

class.name: kontrolem_description/FloatingContactSimSystem
class.description: Standing-WBC simulation hardware (M4): integrates CONTACT-CONSTRAINED floating-base dynamics (feet pinned = the ground) and exports the base pose/twist plus per-foot contact scalars on <gpio> blocks, so a QP-WBC can hold the robot up end-to-end without Gazebo.
